notes: Velum is Cantrip, with all three styles (CEO 2026-09-30: "velum will be cantrip"). A portal saved on a layout its tier does not carry now draws Velum, the default.

Hollow stands on the CEO's painted swamp (art/hollow-swamp.webp, 3840x2160, 0.5 MB, cropped to fit any screen around its far waterline). The lights flicker on the painting's own water, and the ghost rises over it.
Hollow's fog rolls: two banks of patchy fog drift across the water at different speeds, the near one over the lights and the ghost.
Hollow's time is set in UnifrakturCook, a blackletter face (OFL). It was chosen over Grenze Gotisch, whose numbers read as plain serif.
